title: fix(plugin-detail): a related list's bulk delete with refused rows says why, not only how many
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_ Fixes #37816 PR #37809 made the list page's bulk Delete say why records were refused. The related list on a record page has its own bulk delete, and its outcome line still gave only "2 deleted, 1 failed". The user could not tell which rows were refused or why. ## Premise, measured - **Item 1 (related list): holds.** On `main`, `handleConfirmBulkDelete` in `RelatedList.tsx` kept `{ succeeded, failed }` only. When the batch call answered with named errors, they were dropped. A batch call that threw only went to `console.error`. A rejected row delete counted as one failure and nothing more. `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx` pinned `2 deleted, 1 failed` for a batch answer that names `q3` with the reason `refused`. - **Item 2 (view-declared `operation: 'delete'`): does not hold.** A `bulkActionDefs[]` entry with `operation: 'delete'` does not go through `recordDelete`. It runs in `BulkActionDialog`, through `useBulkExecutor` and `executeBulkBatch`. That dialog's result panel already lists every refused record by its title, with its own reason (`userMessage ?? error`). This holds on the batch path (the ids the data source names, objectui#13442) and on the row-by-row fallback. A new pin on the real `ObjectGrid` measures both paths; it passes on `main` unchanged. No fix is needed there. ## What changes - **`@object-ui/core`:** - The grouping rule behind the list page's `refusalSummary` is exported as `bulkDeleteRefusalLines(deps, refused)`. It returns the lines: one per distinct reason, led by up to three row names and then `+N`, at most three reasons and then "And N more". An external-datasource refusal reads as the read-only sentence. `refusalSummary` now joins these lines, so the list page's toast is byte-identical. - `err` may be the reason's text itself, because a batch call names each failed id's error as a string. - **`@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`RelatedList`):** - The outcome now keeps each refused row's reason, from one of three sources: - the ids the batch call names (a plain count names none); - a batch call that throws, whose error is given for every row; - each rejected row delete. - Under the count it lists the grouped lines (`data-related-bulk-delete-reasons`), inside the same `role="status"` region. The count keeps its own `

`. A long reason wraps (`[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`). - The two line keys join the plugin's fallback table. They already exist in every locale pack (#37809). ## Decisions made here - **Reuse the rule, not copy it.** The related list calls core's export, so the two surfaces cannot drift. - **Lines inline, not a toast.** The related list's outcome is an on-screen status line that stays after the re-read (objectstack#35892). The reasons go under it rather than into a new toast. - **A thrown batch call is a reason for every row.** On `main` that path showed "0 deleted, N failed" with nothing else. Its error is the one answer the user has. The rows are named because the whole batch was refused. - **Item 2 gets a pin, not a change.** It already does what the card asks. The pin keeps that measured. ## Verification - `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx` gains three cases, and the existing partial-failure case reads the count's `

`: - A refused batch names three rows with two reasons. Expected: `Quote 2, Quote 4: ` and `Quote 3: Record is locked`, in input order. - Row by row, two rejections with the same reason make one line. A batch call that throws lists `Quote 1, Quote 2: Service unavailable` under `0 deleted, 2 failed`. - **CONTROL:** a batch that answers with a plain count (2 of 3) keeps the bare `2 deleted, 1 failed`, with no reason list. - `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/declaredBulkDeleteReasons-37816.test.tsx` (2) is the item 2 measurement: batch path with named errors, and row by row. - `vitest` over `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `core/src/actions`, app-shell's `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`, and the new grid pin: 591 files, 6,679 passed. The core `recordDelete` tests are unchanged and green. - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for core, plugin-detail and plugin-grid: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors. - `overlap-check`: exit 0. Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint` on the changed files passes (the full `pnpm lint` runs in CI). - [x] 4.
